title: The Specificity Cost of Reducing ECG Lead Information for High-Sensitivity Detection of Occlusion Myocardial Infarction
description: Analysis code and provenance for the prespecified comparison of four ECG lead-information configurations for high-sensitivity detection of angiography-defined occlusion myocardial infarction. Version 1.1.1 corrects the public P3 patient-cluster bootstrap helper introduced in v1.1.0 and updates release metadata. The package contains no patient data, hidden labels, model checkpoints, or row-level predictions.
